title: Audit Activity Browser: advanced search, pagination, and export presets
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Operators and security teams need a fast, secure way to inspect tenant audit logs in the Console and extract relevant slices for incident triage and compliance. Current Console audit view is limited: no cursored pagination, exports are basic, and saved filters are brittle with RBAC v2 and SSO role mappings.

Scope: Implement an Audit Activity Browser feature with advanced text/field filters, cursor-based pagination, CSV and newline-delimited JSON export (streaming for large result sets), and persisted query presets (referred to as presets). Enforce RBAC v2 permissions and align with SAML/SSO group mappings so only authorized principals can view/export. Update Console UX and expose a stable admin API for programmatic exports.

Out of scope: long-term cold storage access UI (will be routed to a separate infra ticket), cross-tenant aggregated exports, and ad-hoc retention policy changes.

Why now: Dedicated and Private customers have requested better audit tooling for compliance audits and incident investigations. RBAC v2 rollout requires Console enforcement points and export controls before GA.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows search field and structured filter chips (actor, action, resource, outcome, time range) and results update within SLA for typical 30s queries
Pagination implemented via opaque cursors (no offset), default page size 100, max page size 1000
Export button produces CSV and ndjson formats; for >10k rows export streams directly from backend to S3-presigned URL or direct browser stream depending on environment
Only principals with role audit.viewer or admin (RBAC v2) can see/export; authorization checks enforced in backend endpoints and Console client
Presets (saved queries) can be created, renamed, deleted; presets inherit RBAC visibility rules and can be shared within orgs
Backend API documented (OpenAPI) and covered by end-to-end tests and a small performance test (1M events/hour simulated load)
Security review completed and SAML group-to-role mappings tested with sandbox IdP
UI A11y checks pass basic keyboard navigation and screen reader labels for filters and export controls
progress_updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created after PM kickoff; scoped with Compliance lead (K. Moreno)
2026-02-24: Spike completed: compared cursor vs offset strategies; chose cursor-based due to high-cardinality timestamps and retention windows
2026-02-27: Backend API sketch posted in GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1597; initial schema includes GET /audit/events (cursor,page_size,filters) and POST /audit/exports
2026-02-28: Design mocks uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/designs/audit-browser-v2; feedback from UX that presets should include description and owner fields
2026-03-01: Initial RBAC gating implemented in dev: only org owners and roles mapped to audit.viewer can access the /audit endpoints locally; working with SSO team to test SAML group sync
decisions: Export formats: support CSV for compliance teams and newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) for tooling; compressed (.gz) optional in backend job
Pagination: use opaque cursor tokens referencing (timestamp, shard_offset) instead of offset to avoid missing/duplicating events during live ingestion
Presets naming: call saved queries 'presets' to avoid confusion with 'saved dashboards'; presets are objects stored in metadata service with ACLs
RBAC: enforce at API layer; audit.viewer role required to view, audit.export permission required to export. Admin role implies both. This reduces blast radius for delegated users.
SSO/SAML integration: map SAML group claims to RBAC roles in the provisioning flow; fallback to SCIM groups for private deployments
Export delivery: for hosted Console use streaming download; for very large exports use backend job that writes to customer-owned S3 via presigned URL to avoid blocking runtime nodes
todos: Complete backend cursor implementation and unit tests
Wire RBAC v2 checks into /audit endpoints and add audit-level logging for exports
Implement export backend job with S3 presigned flow and streaming fallback for browser-size payloads
Finish Console UI: filter chip UX, presets modal, export UX with progress indicator
Coordinate SAML test with infra: sandbox IdP mapping and nightly sync test
Add e2e tests and perf benchmark harness (1M events/hour) and record baseline
notes: Edge-case consideration: exporting while retention job is deleting old events will return consistent cursor snapshots — backend will snapshot query results for export jobs to maintain consistency. We will roll this out to a subset of orgs (canary) and monitor export success rate and time-to-first-byte metrics.
